rules.fact: Durnan's Scalding Mornbrew, handed over with Scalding Mornbrew Delivery (3364) by Nori Pridedrift, vanishes after 300 s, so the run to Durnan Furcutter goes straight after the accept.
Grund and Gozwin (97277) is doable at its minimum level 4 once the level-4 spells are trained.
Camping 101: Cooking (96629) needs Cooking learned from Gremlock Pilsnor in Kharanos before the turn-in; the lesson costs copper, which a fresh character has spent on class training on arrival.
Taking Shimmer Stout (413) closes Rejold's New Brew (415, from Pilot Bellowfiz): it is no longer offered.
Old Icebeard is an elite yeti who patrols out of his cave; Tundra MacGrann's meats (312) are taken while he is away, without a fight.
Rime's Wrath (99160) Minor Ice Elementals are finished at the small lake west of Misty Pine Refuge.
Each Warsong update for The Warsong Reports (6543) is traded for a Warsong Report, which only comes out of the Bundle of Reports (16783) Kadrak gives on accept; it is opened at Kadrak.
Coarse Thread for The Chill of Death (375) is vendor-only: bought from Abigail Shiel in Brill before Gretchen.
The Bronze Tube for Look to the Stars (174) is bought from Herble Baubbletump in Darkshire, next to Viktori; the export's drop in Stonetalon is wrong.
The Blackwood Corrupted (4763) needs the Cleansing Bowl filled at the Auberdine Moonwell first, then the samples, then the summon at the bonfire.
The Divined Scroll for Elemental Bracers (1016) is made with the Divining Scroll from 5 Intact Elemental Bracers.
Dalar never offers Stop the Spread (98299): not to an Undead at 19, nor a Tauren at 21.
Dalar offers the Forever Arugal's Folly (98298) only after the Classic 421-424, 99 series.
Harvesting the Harvesters (92910) starts from a 0.09% drop: never required, taken only if it drops.
The second Harvesting the Harvesters (92911) follows the optional 92910: never required.
As Above, So Below (99152) needs level 10 on Forever and has no prerequisite.
The One That Got Away (99153) needs level 10 on Forever and has no prerequisite.

rules.unconfirmed: seen in recorded runs only; Forever's quest data shows no prerequisite and reqlevel 2 (or minLevel 4), still to confirm in game
rules.fact: A Light in the Darkness (98389) was not offered before The Damned (376) was handed in, in recorded runs; unconfirmed, as Forever's data shows no prerequisite.
Brave Moonhorn offers Message to Freewind Post (4542) from level 23.
Dragonslayer's Helm (78132, Alonso) is Warrior-only, both factions (maintainer decision 2026-10-19).
Dragonslayer's Shield (78133, Alonso) is Warrior-only, both factions (maintainer decision 2026-10-19).
Dragonslayer's Lance (78134, Alonso) is Warrior-only, both factions (maintainer decision 2026-10-19).
A Pain in the Neck (96873) is for enchanters only.
Zarrin offers Recipe of the Kaldorei (4161) only to cooks, after he teaches Cooking for Camping 101: Cooking (96634).
Frast Dokner offers The Quarry's Smith (95217) to blacksmiths only.
Rediscovering the Light (90902, Undead Paladin) heals 5 Injured Deathguard at Deathknell, done in the first Deathknell pass.
Flight to Auberdine (6342) gives a free hippogryph flight from Vesprystus in Rut'theran Village to Auberdine while the quest is held.
Croaky's Head (91740) starts from the elite Croaky: optional, never required.
Elmpaw's Head (91746) starts from the named elite Elmpaw: optional, never required.
Rear Guard Patrol (99156) needs Riptear, a level 13 elite: optional, never required.
WANTED: Vulgara the Insatiable (93318): Vulgara is elite, so it is optional, never required.
Threat from Below (99052), Orgnil's last naga quest: Aggor the Young is elite, so it is optional, never required.
Test of Strength (1151): Rok'Alim the Pounder is elite, so it is optional, never required.
Mission: Possible But Not Probable (2478): Gallywix is elite, so it is optional, never required.
WANTED: Bruuz (92706): Bruuz is elite, so it is optional, never required.
Twitching Antennae (Trial at the Field of Giants, 1824) vanish after 900 s: gathered after Gann's last turn-in, then hearth.

Kristof's Report for Patience (99141) is handed over by Deathguard Kristof when asked (gossip); the data has no source for it.
